title: TuneLoop: Music Playlist Engine
context: Streaming apps manage queues, 'recently played' and offline caches. Each of these maps to an array or linked structure.
input: Songs (id, duration, plays, artist); listening history as an array of ids.

milestones.title: Most played song
milestones.requirement: Plays per song with a count array.

milestones.title: Party elimination game
milestones.requirement: Josephus-style elimination round over a circle of songs (recurrence).

milestones.title: Queue duration
milestones.requirement: Total duration of any range of the queue with prefix sums.

milestones.title: At most two artists
milestones.requirement: Longest stretch of history with at most 2 distinct artists.

milestones.title: Song at a given time
milestones.requirement: Which song plays at second t: lower bound on cumulative durations.

milestones.title: Offline cache
milestones.requirement: Keep the last C played songs offline (LRU).
